Object = the proposal version (the agent's account of the action, not the action); tell = the failure mode that a check would have caught, 'boring' after enough runs (L123). Maintainer block (L151-154) holds no per-phase failure rows or leap tests to cross-check, so nothing filed below the fence that a student could catch in the moment.
